# Savile Row Eyewear

> British luxury eyewear brand crafting handmade frames in 18K rolled gold and Italian Mazzucchelli acetate, continuing the heritage of London's historic Algha Works.

Savile Row Eyewear offers bespoke optical and sun collections featuring iconic designs like the Round Eye, Panto, and Warwick frames (famously worn by Daniel Radcliffe as Harry Potter), alongside the Executive half-moons favored by Queen Elizabeth II. Each frame is handcrafted with customizable temple options including Beaufort, Curl, and Windsor styles.

## Key Topics

- 18K rolled gold frames
- Mazzucchelli acetate
- British craftsmanship
- Algha Works heritage
- Harry Potter glasses
- Round Eye frames
- Panto frames
- Warwick collection
- Executive half-moons
- Beaufort Temples
- Carl Zeiss lenses
- Bespoke eyewear
- Vintage-inspired designs
- Asian fit options
- Sun clips and sunglasses

## Signature Optical Frames

- [Round Eye](https://savileroweyewear.com/product/round-eye): Iconic Round Eye frames with customizable sun clips & Beaufort temples
- [Panto](https://savileroweyewear.com/product/panto): Best-selling Panto frames in palladium/gold/black with temple options
- [Warwick](https://savileroweyewear.com/product/warwick): Warwick round-eye frame in gold/palladium/black, Harry Potter style
- [Executive](https://savileroweyewear.com/product/executive): Classic half-moon frames worn by Queen Elizabeth II, formerly NHS 722
- [Kew](https://savileroweyewear.com/product/kew): 1940s French-inspired acetate frames handcrafted in Italy

## Sunglasses Collection

- [Sun Collection](https://savileroweyewear.com/sun-collection): Complete sunglasses collection featuring 18K gold & acetate frames
- [Panto Sunglasses](https://savileroweyewear.com/product/panto-sunglasses): Panto sunglasses with Carl Zeiss polarised lenses, Italian craftsmanship
- [Warwick Sunglasses](https://savileroweyewear.com/product/warwick-sunglasses): Warwick sunglasses with W-bridge design, Harry Potter inspired style
- [Drury Sunglasses](https://savileroweyewear.com/product/drury-caramel-tortoise-sunglasses): Drury acetate sunglasses in caramel tortoise with Carl Zeiss lenses
- [Savile Row Palladium Aviator](https://savileroweyewear.com/savile-row-palladium-aviator): Vintage 1980s Palladium Aviator sunglasses made in London by Algha Works
